attributes.readMe:
## Tracking Number (TN)

Holds the number, the carrier code, and a `trackingUrlPattern` containing the single placeholder `{number}`. `trackingUrl` is computed from those three.

**The block knows no carriers.** The pattern is data the consumer supplies — the `Carrier` card stores it and `DispatchShipmentCommand` stamps it onto the shipment when the label is created. Adding a carrier is a new Carrier card, never a change here.

`grouped` re-spaces the number in fours, because unbroken twelve-digit runs are close to unreadable when someone is reading one back down a phone line.

Atom is the bare monospace number for tight slots. Embedded adds the carrier code, the outbound link (only when a pattern exists — no dead links) and a copy button.

### Example

`SHP-2026-0145` carries a DPD reference with a working pattern; `SHP-2026-0142` shows the DHL variant.

### Non-goals

No live tracking. Nothing here fetches carrier status — the field is a reference and a link. Scans arrive as `TrackingEventField` values on the shipment.
